column1: # settle-1.input.tsv - the HIP-4 settlement law tape (LAW E-11, BIN15 S4).

# 3. a 15 s hole inside a 2 s series: windows across it are refused
# 4. no mark in force at the open; fewer than three inside
# 5. marks exactly at the open and at the expiry; duplicate stamps
# 6. an empty series and a single mark
